About this item

  • Works with Apple Find My (iOS Only): Connect easily through the Apple Find My app—no extra app or subscription needed. Simply add the tracker to the “Items” section, then use your iPhone to find your valuables right away.
  • Find Nearby: When your tracker is within Bluetooth range, you can use the Find My app to play a sound, or simply ask Siri to locate it for you. Tap the “Play Sound” button, and the tracker will emit a clear beep to help you quickly find your items by following the sound.
  • Find Far Away: Once your tracker is beyond Bluetooth range, you can still check its last recorded position in the Find My app. Supported by Apple’s worldwide network and GPS, you can locate your items across the globe and effectively avoid losing them.
  • Smart Location Trackers: Locator with Sound, you'll never have to worry about losing your luggage, keys, bags, or personal belongings again. These trackers are fully compatible with the Find My App (iOS only), allowing you to quickly locate your items no matter where you are.
  • Protect Privacy and Easy Pairing: All location data is end-to-end encrypted and inaccessible to anyone but you, ensuring only you can access your item’s whereabouts.Simply open the Find My app and Bluetooth, tap “Items”, then “Add Item” and select “Other Supported Item”, then follow the on-screen instructions to complete pairing. (Not compatible with Android devices)

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
